title: New Gmail email
description: Starts the workflow for each new email in the connected Gmail account, checked by polling. The input has from (raw header), fromEmail (bare address) and fromName (display name or empty). Attachments are stored as files and listed in attachments (filename, mimeType, size, fileId, skipped). Needs a Gmail connection that granted read access (reconnect older connections).

connectionId.title: Gmail connection
connectionId.description: Gmail connection whose mailbox is watched. Reconnect it if it was created before read access was added.

query.title: Search filter
query.description: Optional Gmail search syntax (for example: from:billing@example.com is:unread). Only matching new emails start a run.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often Weav checks for new email. Defaults to 5.
